code='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    ones = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] == 1]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in ones), max(r for r, c in ones)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in ones), max(c for r, c in ones)
    src = [row[c0:c1 + 1] for row in grid[r0:r1 + 1]]
    outside = [(r, c, grid[r][c]) for r in range(h) for c in range(w)
               if grid[r][c] not in (0, 1) and not (r0 <= r <= r1 and c0 <= c <= c1)]
    colors = [v for r, c, v in outside]
    anchors = {}
    for color in colors:
        pts = [(r - r0, c - c0) for r in range(r0, r1 + 1) for c in range(c0, c1 + 1)
               if grid[r][c] == color]
        if len(pts) == 1:
            anchors[color] = pts[0]
    H, W = len(src), len(src[0])
    transforms = [
        lambda r,c:(r,c), lambda r,c:(c,H-1-r),
        lambda r,c:(H-1-r,W-1-c), lambda r,c:(W-1-c,r),
        lambda r,c:(H-1-r,c), lambda r,c:(r,W-1-c),
        lambda r,c:(c,r), lambda r,c:(W-1-c,H-1-r),
    ]
    def corners(points):
        rs=[p[0] for p in points]; cs=[p[1] for p in points]
        rmin,rmax=min(rs),max(rs); cmin,cmax=min(cs),max(cs)
        return [(int(r==rmax) if rmax!=rmin else 0,
                 int(c==cmax) if cmax!=cmin else 0) for r,c in points]
    target = corners([(r,c) for r,c,v in outside])
    best = None
    for f in transforms:
        mapped = [f(*anchors[v]) for v in colors if v in anchors]
        relevant = [i for i,v in enumerate(colors) if v in anchors]
        score = sum(corners(mapped)[j] != target[i] for j,i in enumerate(relevant)) if mapped else 99
        if best is None or score < best[0]: best=(score,f)
    f=best[1]
    coords=[f(r,c) for r in range(H) for c in range(W)]
    oh=max(r for r,c in coords)+1; ow=max(c for r,c in coords)+1
    out=[[1]*ow for _ in range(oh)]
    for r in range(H):
        for c in range(W):
            nr,nc=f(r,c); out[nr][nc]=src[r][c]
    if any(r < r0 for r,c,v in outside):
        out=[[1]*ow]+out
    return out
'''
